title: A review of Ni-based layered oxide cathode materials for alkali-ion batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4419-4467
DOI: 10.1039/D3CS00911D, Review Article
Lei Wang, Jiaqing Wang, Yifei Lu, Suqiao Fang, Chao Yang, Xingqiao Wu, Yao Xiao, Yong Wang, Shulei Chou, Shuangqiang Chen
Nickel-based layered oxide (NLO) cathodes have shown high capacities and good cyclabilities. This review discusses the challenges of NLO cathodes in alkali-ion batteries (AIBs). Perspectives and strategies are further proposed to accelerate the AIBs.
